review:
A café full of cakes, jellies, coffee and candy canes. When a wild lands, it stays put and the reels keep respinning until no new wilds appear.

In those respins, up to five wilds can carry a 10x multiplier. Three scatter swirls give six free spins, and four or five start you with two or three wilds already in place. Up to 7,500x, 96.01% RTP. Sweet and simple.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
